name: openlegaldata-retrieval-benchmark
description: A document-retrieval benchmark built from OpenLegalData aimed at evaluating retrieval systems on legal texts. It measures the ability to find and rank relevant legal documents or passages given legal queries across jurisdictions and document types. The benchmark is intended for evaluating IR and dense retrieval models in legal NLP settings.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for legal retrieval tasks with interest among legal-NLP researchers but limited broader adoption.
